_about: Per-country settings for build_zones.py, keyed by the feature name used in site/countries.js.
cc: ISO code. Only features with a cc (or island) can get per-zone regions; the page has names only.
extra_zones: zones added to the country's list. The page lists only Europe/Paris for France, but its overseas departments are in other zones.
extra_cc: more country codes whose zone.tab places belong to this country.
drop_zones: zones removed from the list; their land is listed under (and takes the time of) the country's main zone. Crimea (Europe/Simferopol) is Ukrainian and follows Europe/Kyiv.
island: small dependencies that inherited their parent country's whole zone list in the page. They get the zone(s) that really cover them, and no markers.
